item.title: About
item.description:
Hey there , Im Alfin Joseph a.k.a alfin. I am Currently doing my undergraduate in Computer Science and Engineering from Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham, India. 🇮🇳

My Interests 🎯

  • Security Engineer CRED
  • Web security researcher and CTF player.
  • My focus has been mainly on client-side vulnerabilities.
  • Currently doing research and CTF’s with bi0s and Project Sekai.

Security Advisories

  • CVE-2023-52555 Discovered a Cross-Site Request Forgery(CSRF) in Mongo-Express .
  • CVE-2025-00192 Discovered a Medium Severity XSS vulnerability in OpenUI .
  • CVE-2025-00660 Discovered a Stored XSS vulnerability in Concrete CMS .
